message: 遅刻の黙示録

name: Synn
message: 「Wait for me, Lolotte. I'll definitely get stronger and come back to Ryuusei Academy.」
I murmur to myself inside the Rosenkreuz family's transport aircraft, the "Ojou-sama Copter."
No one answers. I'm sitting in the passenger cabin all alone. And in the cockpit is Riesling. The two of us are the only ones on board.

name: Riesling
message: 「We have exited the Air Defense Identification Zone. Deploying chaff and initiating evasive maneuvers. Please fasten your seatbelt.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but got it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Coastline spotted. Course four-zero-three, mark eighteen, initiating Omega navigation. Estimated arrival at the training grounds is astronomical twilight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, sir.」
I don't even understand half of what he's saying, yet I nod with complete peace of mind.
Leave it to Riesling and nothing can go wrong. After all, he's the butler Lolotte trusts wholeheartedly.
Lolotte herself isn't on board, and I deliberately left Paqy behind to watch the place.
I'm doing this to train myself without relying on my familiar, Paqy. And Riesling is here to put me through my paces.
All of it is sure to help me protect Lolotte and everyone in the Crusaders.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, tonight's demon put up a tough fight.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawaa!? Mr. President, you're hurt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Oh, I'm fine. A scratch like this will heal if I just leave it alone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu... No, please let me treat you properly.」
As Lolotte casts healing Spirit Arts on me, my wounds begin to close. The fatigue of battle fades away, my parched throat feels refreshed, and my energy wells back up.
In the middle of it all, a thought suddenly strikes me.
Could it be that Lolotte's Spirit Arts are this gentle and powerful precisely because she's an angel?
If a person's abilities before transforming carry over after transformation--

name: Synn
message: 「That's it! I need to train my body!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoheh?」
Through Melilot's connections, it was arranged for me to join a special forces training program for about two weeks. The schedule gets me back in time for the Holy Night Festival.

name: Riesling
message: 「We are under ambush. Vulcan Phalanx fire, zero-point-three seconds to impact.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's going on!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Nuclear electromagnetic pulse detected. C3 systems have been rendered inoperable. Transitioning to visual approach.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are we being fired on?! Isn't this supposed to be training?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「This is live-fire training.」

name: Synn
message: 「I never heard anything about--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, fire!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Jamming smoke on the flank, unidentified vessel below」

name: Riesling
message: 「Chaff dispenser active. Igniting composite propellant, suppressing stall flutter」

name: Riesling
message: 「Turbine damaged; 42 seconds until reactor core detonation」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Detonation!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san, shouldn't you be piloting?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Passing the drop point right on schedule. Thrust currently at one-third; engines switched to normal impulse」

name: Synn
message: 「Say it so I can understand!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Altitude 3,000 meters; a parachute drop is possible without an oxygen tank」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't seriously be telling me to jump from here?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the training of the young mistress's partner to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Riesling
message: 「I shall accompany you until you return alive from Ryuusei Town or perish in battle, Synn-sama」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hello? Angels are number one, telephones are number two, and falling at three o'clock is Riesling Tooyama」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena♪ Tamiko-chan, could you put Synn-chan on?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helloooooooooooooooo?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan? You're holding a backpack with food and stuff right now, aren't you? I put a reward inside, so open it up and look」

name: Synn
message: 「Rummage, rummageeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep, yep. I threw out the water, canned food, and first-aid kit to cram that trophy in, so figure something out once you land♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Helena...」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't get mad~ Instead, I packed two months' worth of fried rice vermicelli into Tamiko's backpack」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood」

name: Synn
message: 「Two monthsssss!? Heyyyyy! Wasn't training supposed to be two weeksssss!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san, helloooo! Helloooooo!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhhh」
From the jolt of the parachute opening, I dropped my cell phone. Picking it back up is completely impossible.

name: Riesling
message: 「Landing at the beachhead in 15 minutes. It will be a decisive battle beyond the lines」

name: Synn
message: 「...Such intense combat right off the bat?」
Regardless of my own will, the parachute keeps descending.
Ah, even though I wished for this myself, what day will it be when I can return to everyone?
I have to make it back alive before Re-Crea begins in earnest...
